name: FFDNet Color (clipped)

output.name: denoised
output.domain: direct clean RGB sRGB, not residual

reference.oracle: Independent NumPy convolution/unshuffle/shuffle vs ONNX ReferenceEvaluator; identical unchanged official learned weights

conversion.deterministicReexport: passed; repeated graph build produces identical bytes

inferenceGuidance.pixelPhase: Tile origins and halo must remain even to preserve pixel-unshuffle phase
inferenceGuidance.receptiveField: 12 low-resolution 3x3 convolutions: radius24 full-resolution pixels plus pixel phase; halo32 covers it
inferenceGuidance.boundary: Replicate image boundaries in the caller; this differs from zero-filled convolutions at the outer edge of a whole-image evaluation

limitations: Post-development SDR RGB denoising; not a camera-RAW sensor denoiser or Adobe model
Trained clipped Gaussian-noise model; real camera noise and detail preservation require scene-level validation
No AI source image is uploaded by the model itself
